summary: Richard Cooke, managing director for the UK and Northern Europe at Rocco Forte Hotels (including Brown's Hotel), becomes general manager of Hotel Bel-Air from 1 January 2027.
title: Richard Cooke to lead Hotel Bel-Air for Dorchester Collection

visual_text.rest: takes office as General Manager of Hotel Bel-Air for Dorchester Collection.
visual_text.strap: Hotel Bel-Air, Los Angeles · From 1 January 2027

why: A leader shaped on three continents, with 15+ years at Shangri-La, takes over one of Dorchester Collection's most storied addresses.
